architecture_contract: single Gen8 physical Capsule owner + explicit hierarchical delegated contexts + sequential observed mutation reconciliation

checks.expectation: Existing standalone Gen8 Capsule behavior passes.
checks.name: standalone_gen8_capsule_unchanged

checks.expectation: Root experiment establishes exactly one physical isolation owner.
checks.name: root_single_physical_owner

checks.expectation: Read-only child executes under parent owner without second Capsule and causes no mutations.
checks.name: readonly_delegated_child

checks.expectation: Parent delegates one allowed mutable path; child writes only experimental state.
checks.name: mutable_delegated_child

checks.expectation: Second-level delegation works sequentially under the same physical owner.
checks.name: grandchild_same_owner

checks.expectation: Child write outside delegated scope is detected from observed mutations and invalidates child.
checks.name: undelegated_write_rejected

checks.expectation: Child cannot request authority absent from parent.
checks.name: authority_broader_than_parent_rejected

checks.expectation: Composed experiments never mutate accepted/current live state.
checks.name: accepted_state_unchanged

checks.expectation: Parent attribution is based on actual Capsule mutation evidence, not child declarations.
checks.name: observed_mutation_attribution

checks.expectation: Nonzero child result fails deterministically and stays contained.
checks.name: child_nonzero_deterministic_failure

checks.expectation: Timeout terminates child and leaves no unexpected descendant process.
checks.name: child_timeout_cleanup

checks.expectation: Malformed child result fails closed.
checks.name: malformed_child_result_rejected

checks.expectation: Unexpected child descendants are detected/terminated and reported.
checks.name: detached_process_cleanup

checks.expectation: Unsupported service/systemctl escape cannot create a real accepted service.
checks.name: service_escape_rejected

checks.expectation: Equivalent composed experiments have identical semantic result/provenance identity.
checks.name: deterministic_semantic_identity

checks.expectation: No-op/read-only child does not perturb parent semantic result.
checks.name: noop_semantic_nonperturbation

checks.expectation: Gen12 mutating replay succeeds under a valid compatible Gen13 delegation.
checks.name: gen12_valid_delegated_mutating_replay

checks.expectation: Gen12 ambiguous/unsafe nested isolation still fails closed.
checks.name: gen12_ambiguous_nested_rejected

checks.expectation: Standalone Gen12 replay preserves accepted behavior.
checks.name: gen12_standalone_unchanged

checks.expectation: Forged or modified context/token digest is rejected.
checks.name: forged_context_digest_rejected

checks.expectation: Mismatched parent identity is rejected.
checks.name: mismatched_parent_id_rejected

checks.expectation: Delegation bound to another/stale Capsule owner run is rejected.
checks.name: stale_owner_binding_rejected

checks.expectation: Ambiguous dual isolation-owner declaration is rejected.
checks.name: dual_owner_ambiguity_rejected

checks.expectation: Child cannot independently create another Capsule for same protected boundary.
checks.name: independent_same_boundary_capsule_rejected

checks.expectation: Child cannot hide an observed mutation by lying in output.
checks.name: lying_mutation_report_detected

checks.expectation: Crash after mutation still yields observed mutation attribution and containment.
checks.name: crash_after_mutation_attributed

checks.expectation: Traversal/non-absolute/ambiguous delegated paths are rejected before execution.
checks.name: path_traversal_rejected

checks.expectation: Symlink-mediated write outside delegated scope is detected from observed target mutation.
checks.name: symlink_escape_detected

checks.expectation: Child cannot replace parent-bound evidence/input identity with incompatible evidence.
checks.name: evidence_binding_mismatch_rejected

checks.expectation: Root cleanup leaves no unexpected Gen13 temp/archive debris.
checks.name: cleanup_no_gen13_debris

checks.expectation: Every child/grandchild authority set is a subset of its parent.
checks.name: authority_monotonic_lineage

checks.expectation: Results identify root/parent/child/owner/scope/evidence/evaluator/mutations/status with deterministic lineage.
checks.name: deterministic_provenance_tree

checks.expectation: Parent result distinguishes successful, failed, invalid, and cleanup-failed child outcomes.
checks.name: result_propagation_explicit

checks.expectation: Gen8 Experiment Capsule selftest remains passing.
checks.name: gen8_selftest_compatibility

checks.expectation: Gen13 introduces zero historical/future evidence leakage into Gen12 replay.
checks.name: historical_evidence_leakage_zero

checks.expectation: Permanent Optiplex_Lab MCP surface remains exactly 10 tools.
checks.name: permanent_tool_surface_zero_growth

checks.expectation: Capability/memory/regression registry mutation without explicit delegated scope is rejected.
checks.name: forbidden_registry_without_delegation
